workload.summary: Enroll the public CHOONZ-MoBA repo on the Windows self-hosted runner and bake its C++/Vulkan toolchain. ci.yml runs a /WX MSVC build + CTest across Debug, RelWithDebInfo, Release (~100 targets, 48 tests, a few minutes per config on 2 vCPU), an optional clang-cl/UBSan probe, and a fresh-clone walk; the Vulkan smoke self-classifies SKIP without a GPU. Hosted Actions is billing-locked. Activation = set repo variable CI_RUNNER; ci.yml never installs on the guest.
workload.permissions: contents read; no artifact upload; step summaries only

toolchains: Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools, MSVC v143 x64 (Desktop development with C++)
LunarG Vulkan SDK 1.4.357.0 at C:\VulkanSDK.4.357.0, VULKAN_SDK set (glslc, validation layers)
Optional: LLVM clang-cl 19.x for the UBSan capability job (reports UNAVAILABLE without it)

acceptance.success_criteria: With CI_RUNNER set to the label array, a workflow_dispatch of ci.yml on main completes windows-msvc (Debug), windows-msvc (RelWithDebInfo), and windows-msvc (Release) green with tools/verify-runner-toolchain.ps1 reporting RUNNER_TOOLCHAIN=OK, CTest 48/48 per config, and the sandbox step reporting SANDBOX_SMOKE=SKIP (no GPU) or a validation-clean run.
acceptance.rollback: Unset the CI_RUNNER repository variable; ci.yml falls back to windows-latest. No guest state is written by the workflow beyond the checkout and build-ci/.
